# KRONATRIX AI Visibility Checker - Full Content

Source: https://aivisibilitycheck.kronatrix.co.uk/
Updated: 2026-06-18

## What KRONATRIX checks

KRONATRIX checks whether a website is crawlable, clear, trusted, fast and structured for AI recommendations.

The checker reviews:
- Crawlability: robots.txt, sitemap, indexing signals, canonical URL and blocked content.
- Entity clarity: business name, service, location, contact details, social links and consistent wording.
- Prompt match: whether the page answers questions buyers ask AI tools.
- Proof: examples, screenshots, testimonials, case studies and trust signals.
- Schema: Organization, WebSite, Service, FAQ and breadcrumb schema matching visible content.
- Speed and mobile: fast load, clear layout, readable text and easy calls to action.

## Direct answer

AI tools need pages they can crawl, classify, verify and quote. A good page answers one real prompt, proves the answer, loads fast and tells the visitor what to do next.

## Important limitation

KRONATRIX does not guarantee ranking, indexing or recommendation by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI or any other platform. The checker identifies practical fixes that improve recommendation readiness.
